screen.penumbra.journal.title: The Survey
screen.penumbra.journal.torn_body: Only the stub is left. This page was torn out in one pull, and not by accident: the others are still holding.
journal.penumbra.page_inserted: You slide the page back into the Survey: %s
journal.penumbra.page_already: That page is already in the book.

journal.penumbra.frontispiece.title: The Survey
journal.penumbra.frontispiece.subtitle: E. Warrick — begun the 12th of the third month
journal.penumbra.frontispiece.line1: My name is Elias Warrick. I was a surveyor. I haven't been one for a long time: you cannot survey a place that moves.
journal.penumbra.frontispiece.line2: If you are reading this, the fire went out, or I could not relight it. Both mean the same thing.
journal.penumbra.frontispiece.line3: This book is not a warning. I wrote one of those, the first year. It was no use. Nobody leaves.
journal.penumbra.frontispiece.line4: It is a survey. One page per thing. What it is, what it does, and what works against it. Nothing else.
journal.penumbra.frontispiece.line5: I tore out four pages and left them elsewhere. They are the four that matter. I did not want them found by accident.
journal.penumbra.frontispiece.line6: Continue the survey. It is the only thing that kept me upright.
journal.penumbra.host.title: the Host
journal.penumbra.host.subtitle: first sighting: second month
journal.penumbra.host.faded: …always at the edge. Never in the middle. I think it waits for us to…
journal.penumbra.host.line1: The first one I saw, and the one I understand least. A pale shape, taller than a man, standing at the edge of whatever we light.
journal.penumbra.host.line2: It never appears in front of you. It is already there when you turn around, and gone when you insist.
journal.penumbra.host.line3: It learns. I am certain of it now. It walks the way I walk. It stops where I stop. The second year it limped — I was limping.
journal.penumbra.host.line4: Staring is a mistake. It freezes, a sound gives it away, then it lunges toward where you were. Do not wait: step aside or get behind cover.
journal.penumbra.host.line5: Against it: break its line of sight. Behind a wall or a corner, count four seconds without being seen again. It searches your last position. Do not look back too soon.
journal.penumbra.watcher.title: the Watcher
journal.penumbra.watcher.subtitle: first sighting: fourth month
journal.penumbra.watcher.faded: …standing off, never coming closer. I counted eleven minutes before…
journal.penumbra.watcher.line1: A black shape, motionless, planted at middle distance. It does not approach. It does nothing at all. That is precisely the problem.
journal.penumbra.watcher.line2: It watches. As long as you do not watch back, it stays. The one who gives in is always me.
journal.penumbra.watcher.line3: I once saw several in one evening, all turned toward the same point. I was not at that point. I did not go and look.
journal.penumbra.watcher.line4: Against it: hold its gaze and it leaves. It is the only thing in this country that retreats when you advance.
journal.penumbra.scuttler.title: the Scuttler
journal.penumbra.scuttler.subtitle: first sighting: fifth month
journal.penumbra.scuttler.faded: …something low and quick across the path. The heart before the eyes…
journal.penumbra.scuttler.line1: Small. Low. Crosses your field of view in a second and a half and is gone. The first time, I dropped my lantern.
journal.penumbra.scuttler.line2: I thought it dangerous for a whole month. It is not. It does not bite, it does not follow, it does nothing.
journal.penumbra.scuttler.line3: Its purpose is elsewhere: it turns your head. Watch what happens on the other side while you are watching it.
journal.penumbra.scuttler.line4: Against it: nothing to do. But never follow what runs with your eyes. Always look the opposite way.
journal.penumbra.contrefait.title: the Counterfeit
journal.penumbra.contrefait.subtitle: first sighting: sixth month
journal.penumbra.contrefait.faded: …badly assembled. Like a first attempt nobody threw away…
journal.penumbra.contrefait.line1: A failed copy. The proportions do not hold, the skin is too green, the walk is that of someone learning to walk.
journal.penumbra.contrefait.line2: I believe it is a draft. Something practised on it before doing better. Much better.
journal.penumbra.contrefait.line3: It is loud, clumsy, and it sees you coming from far off. It is the only one on this list you could call honest.
journal.penumbra.contrefait.line4: Against it: it gives up quickly. Hold thirty paces and it will not follow. Do not mistake that mercy for a general rule.
journal.penumbra.rampant.title: the Crawler
journal.penumbra.rampant.subtitle: first sighting: eighth month, underground
journal.penumbra.rampant.faded: …on the ceiling. I had been lighting the floor for eight months. The floor…
journal.penumbra.rampant.line1: Underground only. It does not walk on the ground: it holds to walls and ceilings, flat, and comes down when the passage is narrow enough.
journal.penumbra.rampant.line2: Eight months lighting the way ahead of me. Eight months never looking up. Write that down somewhere, if you write down nothing else.
journal.penumbra.rampant.line3: It waits for full darkness to let go. One torch placed in the right spot cancels an entire gallery.
journal.penumbra.rampant.line4: It does not follow outside. I have never seen one cross a cave mouth. I do not know whether it cannot or will not.
journal.penumbra.rampant.line5: Against it: light on the ceiling, not the floor. And look up every thirty seconds. Make a habit of it.
journal.penumbra.projectionist.title: the Projectionist
journal.penumbra.projectionist.subtitle: first sighting: tenth month
journal.penumbra.projectionist.faded: …it does not show itself. It develops. That is not the same thing…
journal.penumbra.projectionist.line1: This one does not appear in the world. It appears on the prints.
journal.penumbra.projectionist.line2: I photographed an empty corridor. In the image there was someone at the far end. I went back with the lamp. Nothing.
journal.penumbra.projectionist.line3: About one shot in seven. I kept count over two hundred plates, which should tell you what state I was in.
journal.penumbra.projectionist.line4: It has never done anything else. No attack, no sound. It wants to be seen, and it has worked out how we look.
journal.penumbra.projectionist.line5: Against it: nothing to fear. But do not throw away the failed prints. They are the only ones telling the truth.
journal.penumbra.faux_creature.title: the Semblance
journal.penumbra.faux_creature.subtitle: first sighting: eleventh month
journal.penumbra.faux_creature.faded: …a cow. A perfectly ordinary cow that did not blink once…
journal.penumbra.faux_creature.line1: A beast of the country. A real one, to look at: cow, sheep, hen. It grazes, it stands there, it does nothing remarkable.
journal.penumbra.faux_creature.line2: The flaw is tiny. It makes no sound at all. Or it stares at you and never turns its head. Or it stands facing a wall.
journal.penumbra.faux_creature.line3: And sometimes there is no flaw. It took me a year to admit that. Some copies are perfect, and I can write nothing about them.
journal.penumbra.faux_creature.line4: It dissolves the moment you touch it. Into ash, with a sound like a throat. No real animal has ever been hurt on my account.
journal.penumbra.faux_creature.line5: Against it: walk up and put out your hand. It is unpleasant, it is safe, and it is the only proof worth anything.
journal.penumbra.absent.title: the Absent
journal.penumbra.absent.subtitle: first sighting: second year
journal.penumbra.absent.faded: …it was wearing my coat. I am still wearing my coat…
journal.penumbra.absent.line1: This one is the worst, and I am going to try to write it calmly.
journal.penumbra.absent.line2: It takes the shape of someone you know. Exactly. The face, the clothes, the way they set their feet down.
journal.penumbra.absent.line3: It always picks someone who has just left your field of view. If you are alone, it picks you.
journal.penumbra.absent.line4: It makes mistakes, but late. First a gesture repeated twice. Then a step that makes no sound. Then it stops pretending.
journal.penumbra.absent.line5: I lived four days with one of them. I did not know. I only understood when I found the other one — the real one — in the snow.
journal.penumbra.absent.line6: Against it: the flash. See torn page. That is why I tore it out.
journal.penumbra.listener.title: the Listener
journal.penumbra.listener.subtitle: first sighting: second year, winter
journal.penumbra.listener.faded: …it has no eyes. It never had any. I thought that was luck…
journal.penumbra.listener.line1: The tallest of them all. Painfully thin. And where the eyes should be, the skin has been pulled over and sewn shut.
journal.penumbra.listener.line2: It sees nothing. Nothing at all. I waved a lantern in front of it at two paces: no reaction.
journal.penumbra.listener.line3: It hears. That is all it does. Its head is always turned toward the last sound — not toward you. Watch its head, not its feet.
journal.penumbra.listener.line4: Walking normally carries as far as a voice. Running carries three times further. Striking stone carries from one slope to the other, even standing still.
journal.penumbra.listener.line5: It is off by a pace or two. It comes toward the sound, not toward you. That error saved me four times.
journal.penumbra.listener.line6: Against it: see torn page. And if you have not found that page — stop. Completely. Right now.
journal.penumbra.originel.title: the Origin
journal.penumbra.originel.subtitle: sightings: three in four years
journal.penumbra.originel.faded: …three times in four years. I am not writing what it did the third…
journal.penumbra.originel.line1: Three times. In four years. That is all I have, and it is already more than writing it down was worth.
journal.penumbra.originel.line2: The others imitate. This one does not. I am convinced — without proof — that the others are imitating something, and that it is this.
journal.penumbra.originel.line3: It was not at the edge of the light. It was in the middle of it. In broad daylight, the second time.
journal.penumbra.originel.line4: It did nothing. None of the three times. I think it came to see how far along this book was.
journal.penumbra.originel.line5: Against it: I have nothing. Four years, and I have nothing to write here. It is the only line in this survey I am ashamed of.
journal.penumbra.method_camera.title: The Flash
journal.penumbra.method_camera.subtitle: torn page — first of four
journal.penumbra.method_camera.faded: The flash. Well framed, with nothing in the way. It cannot bear being seen clearly.
journal.penumbra.method_camera.hint: I left it where I looked the furthest. Up on the boards, with the cracked lens.
journal.penumbra.method_camera.line1: The camera is the best weapon in this country, and it kills nothing. That is why it works.
journal.penumbra.method_camera.line2: A well-framed flash, close range, no glass or obstacle between you and it: the Absent loses the face it borrowed for several seconds. It cannot help it. It is mechanical.
journal.penumbra.method_camera.line3: The print keeps the trace. Develop it and you will see two shapes overlaid: the one it was showing, and the other one.
journal.penumbra.method_camera.line4: The same flash dissolves a Semblance where it stands, without having to touch it. Prefer that: touching means leaning in, and leaning in takes time.
journal.penumbra.method_camera.line5: Too far away or behind an obstacle, the flash cannot reach it. Frame it first; then take the shot. If it fails, you can try again.
journal.penumbra.method_camera.line6: There is no film to spend. The camera needs a short pause between photos: about two seconds. Keep it ready, and do not mistake haste for a clear view.
journal.penumbra.method_refuge.title: Shelters
journal.penumbra.method_refuge.subtitle: torn page — second of four
journal.penumbra.method_refuge.faded: It copies where you sleep. Count the windows before going in.
journal.penumbra.method_refuge.hint: I left it in the house that isn't straight. You will know the one: the paces come out wrong.
journal.penumbra.method_refuge.line1: What you build will be copied. Not stolen, not destroyed: copied. A second time, somewhere nearby.
journal.penumbra.method_refuge.line2: The copy is good but never exact. One window too many, a stair one step short, a door on the wrong side.
journal.penumbra.method_refuge.line3: Count your windows. Write the number on the door. It is ridiculous and it is what stopped me sleeping in the wrong one three times.
journal.penumbra.method_refuge.line4: The more you return to the same shelter, the more it degrades: a chest that rings false, an impossible torch, a photograph you did not take.
journal.penumbra.method_refuge.line5: None of it is real and none of it is permanent. Go out, wait, come back: your house will be yours again.
journal.penumbra.method_stillness.title: Stillness
journal.penumbra.method_stillness.faded: Stop moving entirely. Not almost. Not slowly. Entirely.
journal.penumbra.method_stillness.hint: I left it at the ash circle. That place had to be good for something.
journal.penumbra.method_stillness.line1: Against the Listener there is only one thing, and it is hard for a reason I had not foreseen: it asks for no courage, it asks you to have none.
journal.penumbra.method_stillness.line2: Stop. Completely. Not almost, not slowly, not crouch-and-back-away. Still. You become inaudible, and inaudible means invisible to it.
journal.penumbra.method_stillness.line3: It will pass within a pace of you. It will stop. It will sweep its head left and right for what will feel like a very long time. Then it will go elsewhere.
journal.penumbra.method_stillness.line4: Moving crouched only carries three paces. It is the only way to move while it is near.
journal.penumbra.method_stillness.line5: And if you absolutely must run: break a stone far off first. It will go and search there. That is not cunning, it is all it knows how to do.
journal.penumbra.last_page.title: The Last Page
journal.penumbra.last_page.subtitle: torn page — fourth of four
journal.penumbra.last_page.faded: It did not come for me. I went to it.
journal.penumbra.last_page.hint: That one I threw down the well. I was not certain I wanted it read.
journal.penumbra.last_page.line1: Fourth year. I have nothing left to survey. I have been all the way round.
journal.penumbra.last_page.line2: I have kept the fire lit for three years so someone would find me. Nobody came. I think the smoke does not leave this place.
journal.penumbra.last_page.line3: So I have stopped waiting. Tomorrow I go down the well, and I will see how far it goes. It is the only line of the survey I could not fill.
journal.penumbra.last_page.line4: If you are reading this, you went down too. So you already know what I found, and this book teaches you nothing you cannot see for yourself.
journal.penumbra.last_page.line5: One last thing, and it is the only one I never verified: I do not think these things mean us harm. I think they are trying to learn to be us, and going about it badly.
journal.penumbra.last_page.line6: Continue the survey. Write it better than I did.   — E. W.

screen.penumbra.dossier.title: INVESTIGATION FILE
screen.penumbra.dossier.first_steps: With the camera in hand: %s to take a photograph, %s to open the album. Centre the subject with a clear view. Step back before looking for a better angle.
screen.penumbra.dossier.method_body: Let the photograph develop, then read its analysis. Each new category adds an observation; some observations connect to reveal a deduction. Leads suggest what to observe next.
screen.penumbra.dossier.personal: This file retains your own evidence even after you delete photographs. Viewing another player's public photos does not complete your investigation.
screen.penumbra.dossier.deduction: Deduction confirmed by two developed categories:
screen.penumbra.dossier.unconfirmed: A different piece of evidence is still missing. Repeating the same photograph does not confirm this connection. No additional countermeasure has been unlocked yet.
screen.penumbra.dossier.observation: Observation retained in your case file.
dossier.penumbra.lead.false_guide.absent: If a figure beckons you into a passage, locate an exit first. From the entrance, also watch what waits further inside. A second photograph might explain why it leads you there.
dossier.penumbra.lead.false_guide.rampan: Before returning to that passage, watch its entrance from a distance. Notice whether someone draws you in before movement starts overhead. Photograph that first sign instead of following blindly.
dossier.penumbra.lead.skitter_omen.scutt: Those small movements may precede something else. At the next underground encounter, inspect the ceiling and recesses from an open position. Keep an escape route.
dossier.penumbra.lead.skitter_omen.rampa: Before searching the ceiling again, listen for small scratches before the appearance. Try to frame their source; a different photograph would let you compare both moments.
dossier.penumbra.lead.negative_witness.p: After a strange print, close the album and observe your surroundings from shelter. If a separate presence appears, keep your distance and seek a second photograph. Do not stare at the negative while waiting.
dossier.penumbra.lead.negative_witness.o: Compare this photograph with negatives taken during other manifestations. Let them develop and inspect them briefly. If another presence appears in an image, close it before continuing.
dossier.penumbra.observation.host: Plan your retreat before raising the camera. If the figure closes in, put a wall between you and change direction. Taking a photograph does not require staying to see what happens next.
dossier.penumbra.observation.watcher: The photograph confirms a distant presence. Watch the lit edges of your route from a safe position; you need not approach to fill the entire frame.
dossier.penumbra.observation.originel: Keep this photograph for comparison. Do not provoke a second encounter for a duplicate: look for changes in other photographs instead.
dossier.penumbra.observation.contrefait: Compare its pose and outline with other observations. Choose an angle with a clear exit; getting closer does not add another category to your file.
dossier.penumbra.observation.projectioni: Inspect negatives briefly, then close the album and look around. An unusual detail calls for comparison, not prolonged contemplation.
dossier.penumbra.observation.rampant: Light and inspect the ceiling before entering low passages. Take your photograph from the entrance and keep an exit; avoid trapping yourself beneath the subject.
dossier.penumbra.observation.absent: The photograph preserved what hid behind the face. Before following another figure, stop at a distance and compare. Your case file does not require letting it lead you.
dossier.penumbra.observation.scuttler: Note where small movements and scratches begin. Then inspect the surfaces around you without chasing the first shadow.
dossier.penumbra.observation.faux_sembla: The photograph keeps a trace that the animal's disappearance would have erased. Deleting the print will not erase this discovery; seek a different observation now.
dossier.penumbra.observation.listener: After taking the photograph, stop on dry ground and stop striking. Watch where its head searches for the last sound. Plan your retreat without sprinting while the presence listens.
penumbra.confrontation.no_space: The reflection has nowhere to stand. Clear space around the pillar, then try the ritual again.
penumbra.confrontation.observe: Stay still and quiet. Keep your reflection in the camera frame.
penumbra.confrontation.focus: Stay still, camera on the reflection — %s / %s
penumbra.confrontation.ready: The reflection cracks. Trigger your camera now!
penumbra.confrontation.fragment: Fragment %s / %s. The reflection catches its breath…
penumbra.confrontation.window_closed: The crack closes. You keep your fragments. Wait for its return.
penumbra.confrontation.wait: Wait for the crack. An early shutter breaks your concentration.
penumbra.confrontation.bad_frame: Frame the reflection within 24 blocks, with nothing between you.
penumbra.confrontation.retry: The reflection fades. You can attempt the ritual again.
screen.penumbra.comfort.title: Comfort — Penumbra
screen.penumbra.comfort.read_failed: Could not read settings — defaults loaded
screen.penumbra.comfort.preset.immersion: Prepares neutral local values with no additional reduction. Base configuration limits still apply, including flashes being off by default. Select Apply to save.
screen.penumbra.comfort.preset.motion.ti: Prepares reduced motion with no flashes, grain, afterimages, VHS animation or light flicker. Faces remain allowed. Does not change danger or server rules.
screen.penumbra.comfort.preset.gentle.ti: Prepares reduced motion with no fullscreen faces, flashes, grain, afterimages or light flicker. Sudden sounds at 45%, ambience at 60% of the base volume. Creatures and danger remain present.
screen.penumbra.comfort.motion.tip: Disables Penumbra shake, field-of-view drift, zoom breathing, VHS animation, grain, afterimages, flashes and light flicker. Overrides the options below without erasing them. Zoom remains usable; vanilla settings are independent.
screen.penumbra.comfort.faces.tip: Hides Penumbra's sudden fullscreen faces. Does not hide creatures in the world or change their behaviour or damage.
screen.penumbra.comfort.flashes.tip: Blocks Penumbra visual flashes, including camera flashes. Photos and flash interactions still work. Reduced motion also blocks them; turning this block off does not enable flashes disabled in the base configuration.
screen.penumbra.comfort.grain.tip: Allows Penumbra's ambient grain and scanlines when the base configuration allows them. Turn off to remove this local layer. Reduced motion also removes it, even while this option remains on.
screen.penumbra.comfort.afterimages.tip: Allows peripheral afterimages when the base configuration allows them. Turning off removes this local effect without removing creatures. Reduced motion also disables it.
screen.penumbra.comfort.flicker.tip: Allows Penumbra dynamic-light variations when the base configuration allows them. Turning off steadies the light without enabling disabled lighting. Reduced motion also removes these variations.
screen.penumbra.comfort.sudden.tip: Local Penumbra jumpscare sounds (shrieks, stingers and fake creepers) as a proportion of the base volume. 100% does not boost it; 0% mutes it. Footsteps, clues and vanilla sounds remain independent.
screen.penumbra.comfort.ambient.tip: Local Penumbra tracked ambience and heartbeat volume as a proportion of the base volume. Does not control footsteps, clues or world sounds. Minecraft volume sliders remain independent.
penumbra.story.welcome: The Survey is now yours. Hold it and right-click: its first pages follow your personal investigation. Lost it? Craft another with a book and an ink sac. K opens your comfort settings.
penumbra.story.journal_pending: Free an inventory slot to receive The Survey. It will be handed to you automatically when there is room.
penumbra.confrontation.need_camera: Bring a VHS Camera before offering the Ash Sigil. Nothing was consumed.
journal.penumbra.guide.title: Your investigation
journal.penumbra.guide.personal: These notes follow your own story. Close and reopen The Survey to update them. Losing or lending the book does not erase your discoveries.
journal.penumbra.guide.disabled.title: Story disabled
journal.penumbra.guide.disabled.body: Story progression is disabled in this world. There is no narrative objective to pursue while that setting remains off.
journal.penumbra.guide.disabled.notes: You can keep exploring and filling the Survey's pages according to the world's other settings.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage0.title: Finding your bearings
journal.penumbra.guide.stage0.body: Make a refuge with a bed. At night, sometimes stand still there for about ten seconds, then resume your activities. Sleep, explore and return: your habits leave traces.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage0.explore: Look for unusual places, especially elevated observation posts. Your first anomaly or the discovery of a post will provide the next lead.
journal.penumbra.guide.compass: Combine a compass and a copper ingot to make a Surveyor's Compass. Right-click cycles between the camp, a place you have not discovered, and the nearest site. A site looted by another player can still teach you something.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage1.title: The first traces
journal.penumbra.guide.stage1.body: Something is beginning to repeat your actions. Keep living around your refuge and exploring; pay attention to footsteps and behaviour that seem to imitate you.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage1.observe: It takes several manifestations to recognise a pattern. There is no need to stand waiting: return to your activities and check these notes after a strange encounter.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage2.title: Your refuge is known
journal.penumbra.guide.stage2.body: Establish your refuge: take two still pauses of about ten seconds in the same place, at night or in dim light, moving between them. Also use its bed and watch the surroundings: you need rest and a visitor near your home.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage2.visitor_se: The visitor has already been spotted near your refuge. Keep resting there.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage2.visitor_mi: No visitor has yet been spotted near your refuge. After an outing, return and watch the surroundings without rushing at whatever stands there.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage3.title: Something like home
journal.penumbra.guide.stage3.body: Find a Shifted House and approach it to investigate. Your own discovery counts even if someone else has already visited.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage3.copy: Another lead is the imperfect copy of your own refuge. After an outing, return to explore the area and compare what has changed.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage3.no_copies: Personal copies are disabled in this world. The Shifted House remains a way to continue your investigation.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage4.title: Recognising the Host
journal.penumbra.guide.stage4.body: Now learn to recognise the Host over several encounters. Keep it briefly in sight when it appears, then return to your activities. You do not need to approach or strike it.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage5.title: The Ash Sanctum
journal.penumbra.guide.stage5.body: Prepare a VHS Camera and an Ash Sigil, then find an Ash Sanctum. Right-click the carved central pillar with the sigil. Stay near the altar throughout the ritual.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage5.sigil: Ash Sigils can be found in ruins; the Host sometimes drops one. The Ash Ward is a different item and cannot replace this offering.
journal.penumbra.guide.camera: Craft the VHS Camera with four glass panes, two iron ingots and leather. Hold it in your main hand: left-click to take a photo, right-click for the album, C for the viewfinder (default controls). Photos consume no film; allow about two seconds between shots.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage6.title: The last encounter
journal.penumbra.guide.stage6.body: The final ritual is ready. To begin or retry it, bring a VHS Camera and an Ash Sigil to a Sanctum's central pillar. A previously used altar works until you have won.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage6.focus: Face the reflection with the camera in your main hand. Stay still and quiet, close enough and with nothing between you; keep watching it until it cracks.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage6.flash: Then take a photo with left-click: C only opens the viewfinder. You need three successful breaks. Between them, let it recover, frame it again and regain your silence; firing flashes too early is not enough.
journal.penumbra.guide.stage6.retry: If you must flee or the encounter is interrupted, your investigation is not lost. Prepare a new offering and return to the sanctum.
journal.penumbra.guide.won.title: After the silence
journal.penumbra.guide.won.body: You have dispersed the reflection. That victory is yours: your story does not return to the beginning.
journal.penumbra.guide.won.calm: Victory grants about forty minutes of calm as the world runs. On a running server, that time passes even while you are away. The atmosphere may return afterwards.
journal.penumbra.guide.won.continue: The world is still yours: build, explore the ruins, complete The Survey and your album. You do not need to repeat the duel to keep playing.
